senses.gloss: important or unusual enough to be noticed

definition_translations.zh_TW: 重要或不尋常到值得注意的
definition_translations.ja_JP: 注目に値するほど重要または珍しい
definition_translations.vi_VN: quan trọng hoặc khác thường đến mức đáng chú ý
definition_translations.th_TH: สำคัญหรือแปลกพอที่จะเป็นที่สังเกต

senses.example: Several local notables attended the opening ceremony.

translations.th_TH: บุคคลสำคัญ

example_translations.zh_TW: 數位地方知名人士出席了開幕典禮。
example_translations.ja_JP: 数人の地元の名士が開会式に出席した。

example_translations.vi_VN: Một số nhân vật có tiếng ở địa phương đã tham dự lễ khai mạc.

definition_translations.ja_JP: 重要人物または有名人
definition_translations.vi_VN: người quan trọng hoặc nổi tiếng
definition_translations.th_TH: บุคคลสำคัญหรือมีชื่อเสียง

translations.ja_JP: 注目すべきアプローチ
